correlates.name: Hypospadias with chordee
correlates.presentation: On the newborn exam of a term boy, the urethral opening sits on the underside of the shaft just below the glans rather than at the tip, and the penis bends downward. Both testes are descended. His parents ask for a circumcision before discharge.
correlates.management: Do not circumcise - the urologist uses the foreskin for the repair. Refer to pediatric urology for surgical correction of the opening and the curvature; the lower the opening, the bigger the problem.

correlates.name: Paraphimosis
correlates.presentation: A 10-month-old uncircumcised boy in the ED for a fever workup had a catheterized urine sample taken 4 hours ago and has cried inconsolably since. The glans is swollen, dark purple and tense, with a tight ring of retracted foreskin behind it.
correlates.management: Emergency: reduce it by hand at once - steady pressure with gauze for grip, pushing the glans back through the ring and the foreskin forward; urology if it fails. Always return a retracted foreskin after a catheterization.

correlates.name: Physiologic phimosis
correlates.presentation: Parents of a healthy uncircumcised 3-year-old worry because his foreskin will not pull back over the glans. He voids with a strong, straight stream and has no pain, redness, swelling or infections. Exam: narrow, nontender foreskin opening; glans not visible.
correlates.management: Reassure: normal in uncircumcised boys; the adhesions loosen with time, especially toward the teens. Clean the outside only and leave it alone - forcing it back can tear and scar it or trap it behind the glans.

correlates.name: Hair tourniquet syndrome
correlates.presentation: A 4-month-old has cried inconsolably for 6 hours and is feeding poorly. Afebrile, HR 168, otherwise well-appearing; ears, abdomen and diaper area normal. With the socks off, the left second toe is swollen and red-purple beyond a thin, deep groove encircling its base.
correlates.management: A vascular emergency: cut the constricting strand off at once, through the groove, before the digit dies (sedation, or the ED, if it is wrapped around the penis). In any inconsolable infant, look in the diaper and under the socks.

correlates.name: Labial adhesions
correlates.presentation: A 3-year-old girl has had two afebrile bladder infections this year and burns when she pees. Exam: the labia minora are joined in the midline along their lower two-thirds by a thin, pale line, leaving a small opening above; no bulge or discharge.
correlates.management: None if mild and symptom-free - they part as estrogen rises toward adolescence. Symptomatic: estrogen cream for 2-3 weeks until they separate, then petroleum jelly so they do not re-fuse (steroid cream an alternative). Never pull apart.
